import sys

x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
sn, sd = 10000000, 1
for den in range(1, n + 1):
    floor_num = x * den // y
    ceil_num = floor_num + 1
    diff_floor = abs(x * den - floor_num * y)
    diff_ceil = abs(x * den - ceil_num * y)
    if diff_floor <= diff_ceil:
        num = floor_num
    else:
        num = ceil_num
    if abs(x * sd - sn * y) * den > abs(x * den - num * y) * sd:
        sn = num
        sd = den
print(f"{sn}/{sd}")
</translated_code>
